This is my own money review!!!
Since the pups are eating eomuk, I want to eat it too... 🍢🍥🤍

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:

reviews.content_en:
My pup loves it so much!

But seeing her play with this makes me feel reassured!

reviews.name: 밀****
reviews.content: ㅋㅋㅋ바스락거리고 삑삑거리는데에다가 노즈워크까지 가능해서 가성비 좋아요
reviews.content_en: 😂 It crinkles and squeaks, plus nose work is possible, so it's great value!

reviews.name: 신****
reviews.content: 우선, 비쥬얼이 너무너무 귀여워요! 프로모션중이라 가격도 착하게 구매해서 대만족입니다!! 떡이랑 어묵부분이 야무지게 분리가 되요~~기본 노즈워크 기능을 갖추고 있는데다가 떡 안에 삑삑이도 들어있고 간식까지 숨길수 있어서 1석3조 장난감 입니다.처음에는 그냥 가지고 놀다가 떡이랑 어묵을 분리하려고 한3분정도 사투아닌 사투를 벌이더니 떡을 빼고나서는 또 떡만 가지고 노네요. 떡말이 어묵이 사람음식이라 아이가 맛볼수는 없지만 장난감 덕분에 즐거운 하루가 되었습니다. 감사합니다♡
reviews.content_en: First, the visuals are so adorable! I bought it at a promotional price, so I'm very satisfied!! The tteokmal and eomuk parts separate really well~~ It has basic nose work function, and with a squeaker inside the tteokmal AND the ability to hide treats, it's a 1-toy-3-ways toy! At first my pup just played with it, but then spent about 3 minutes fighting to separate the tteokmal and eomuk. After taking out the tteokmal, she just plays with that. Even though tteokmal and eomuk are human food so she can't taste the real thing, the toy made for a fun day. Thank you! ♡

reviews.name: j****
reviews.content:
너무귀여워요ㅎㅎ가지고 논 후 떡실신했네요ㅎㅎㅎ
여기저기 간식 숨겨놓을칸이 너무많아서 좋아요
바잇미제품은 튼튼하고 신경써서 잘 만들었다는 생각이 많이들어서 고민없이 구매합니다
강아지를 많이생각하는 제품들에 항상 감동입니다
reviews.content_en: It's so cute 😄 She went into eomuk coma after playing with it 😂😂 There are so many places to hide treats here and there, which is great! I buy BITE ME products without hesitation because I'm always impressed by how sturdy they are and how carefully they're made. I'm always touched by how much thought goes into these products for dogs.

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
받자마자 디자인이 너무 귀여워서 놀랐어요!
평소 삼진어묵을 즐겨먹는데 이렇게 귀여운 강아지 삼진어묵 콜라보 장난감이 생겨서 너무 좋아요. 볼때마다 자꾸 어묵이 먹고싶네요ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
워낙 성격이 급한 강아지라 전에 다른 곳에서 구매했던 노즈워크 장난감은 너무 금방 간식을 찾아버려서 아쉬웠는데 이건 굉장히 오래 집중해서 찾아 먹더라고요. 작은 장난감인데도 오랜 시간 갖고 놀 수 있어서 좋아요👍🏻 혹시나 장난감의 벨크로가 강아지 코에 아프지는 않을지 걱정되어서 제 코에도 살짝 대봤는데 정말 부드럽더라고요! 앞으로 노즈워크 장난감은 꼭 바잇미에서 사야겠어요.
reviews.content_en:
I was surprised by how cute the design was when I got it!
I usually enjoy Samjin eomuk, so I'm so happy about this adorable dog collaboration toy! It makes me want to eat eomuk every time I see it 😂😂😂
My dog has a quick temper, and the nose work toy I bought elsewhere before was disappointing because she found the treats too fast. But with this one, she concentrates really hard for a long time to find and eat them. Even though it's a small toy, she can play with it for a long time, which is great 👍🏻 I was worried the velcro on the toy might hurt her nose, so I tested it on my own nose and it was really soft! From now on, I'm only buying nose work toys from BITE ME.

reviews.name: 현****
reviews.content: 강아지도 안 키우는데 인스타그램에서 바잇미가 삼진어묵이랑 콜라보 한 걸 보고 바잇미를 알게 되었는데 너무 귀엽고 리얼해서 저도 모르게 어느순간 구매 버튼을 누르고 있더라고요... ㅎㅎ 고등학생이라 돈은 별로 없지만 앞으로 친구 강아지에게 조공할 겸 자주 살 예정입니다 ㅎㅎ 할인도 자주 하고 택배 박스에 유기견 관련된 캠패인을 하는 스티커가 붙여져있어서 홍보도 잘 될 거 같아요! 그리고 제일 중요한 제품 리뷰를 하자면 아직 강아지가 써보지는 않았지만 제가 느낀 바로는 부드럽고 말랑말랑 뽀시락뽀시락 너무 귀엽고 마감도 되게 잘 돼있어서 오래 쓸 거 같아요!! 나중에 강아지 장난감 말고 전시용 인형으로 둬도 귀여울 거 같은 비주얼들입니다... 제발 사세요 꼭 사세요 절 믿고 구매해주세요 여러분 ㅠㅠㅠ 그리고 다른 귀여운 장난감들도 꼭 사세요 강추!!! 그리고 부스틱이라는 간식도 사은품으로 넣어주시더라구요 친구 강아지한테 줘보고 잘 먹으면 이것도 사볼 예정입니다 ㅎㅎ 믿고 사는 바잇미 사랑합니다 앞으로도 이런 귀여운 거 많이 만들어주세요 제가 다 살게요 ㅠㅠ❤️❤️
reviews.content_en: I don't even have a dog, but I saw BITE ME's collaboration with Samjin eomuk on Instagram and found out about BITE ME. It's so cute and realistic that before I knew it, I was clicking the purchase button... 😅 As a high school student, I don't have much money, but I plan to buy these often to give to my friends' dogs. BITE ME does frequent discounts, and the shipping box has stickers for abandoned dog campaigns, so it should get good publicity! And for the most important product review—while I haven't had my own dog try it yet, from what I can tell, it's soft, squishy, crackly, and so adorable with great finishing. I think it'll last a long time! It would even look cute as a display figurine rather than a dog toy... Please buy it, really please buy it, trust me and purchase it everyone 😭😭😭 And please buy the other cute toys too—highly recommend!!! They also included a snack called Boost Stick as a free gift, so I'm planning to try it on a friend's dog and buy it too if they like it 😄 I love BITE ME because I trust and buy from them. Please keep making cute things like this in the future 😭😭❤️❤️

reviews.content:

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
1. 우선 떡말이어묵과 어묵고로케 비닐 겉 포장지에 귀여운 삼진어묵 로고와 리얼하고 앙증맞은 디자인이 조화롭게 잘 만들어졌어요 저희 반려견 연두(4.6kg)가 가지고 놀기에 안성맞춤 크기에요 
2. 난이도는 떡말이어묵보다 어묵고로케가 조금 더 높아 보여요. 연두처럼 노즈워크 경험이 많은 댕댕이들은 시간이 조금 더 걸리더라도 잘 해낼수 있어요!! 특히 어묵고로케는 발과 코를 더 많이써서 두뇌활동에 좋은 자극이 될것 같아요
3. 떡말이어묵과 어묵고로케 장난감 재질이 쫀쫀하고 안전해보여요
4. 평소 좋아하는 삼진어묵과 바잇미 콜라보로 연두랑 놀이할때도 귀여워서 더 자주 손이 가요
reviews.content_en:
1. The outer packaging of both the tteokmal eomuk and eomuk croquette has the cute Samjin eomuk logo and a realistic, perfectly-sized design. The size is just right for our pup Yeongdu (4.6kg) to play with!
2. The eomuk croquette seems slightly more difficult than the tteokmal eomuk. Dogs with lots of nose work experience like Yeongdu can still figure it out, even if it takes a bit longer!! The eomuk croquette especially requires more use of paws and snout, which seems like good mental stimulation.
3. Both the tteokmal eomuk and eomuk croquette toys have a chewy, safe material.
4. Since they're a collaboration between Samjin eomuk and BITE ME, which Yeongdu loves anyway, I find myself reaching for them more often during playtime because they're so cute!

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
1. 우선 떡말이어묵과 어묵고로케 비닐 겉 포장지에 귀여운 삼진어묵 로고와 리얼하고 앙증맞은 디자인이 조화롭게 잘 만들어졌어요 저희 반려견 연두(4.6kg)가 가지고 놀기에 안성맞춤 크기에요 
2. 난이도는 떡말이어묵보다 어묵고로케가 조금 더 높아 보여요. 연두처럼 노즈워크 경험이 많은 댕댕이들은 시간이 조금 더 걸리더라도 잘 해낼수 있어요!! 특히 어묵고로케는 발과 코를 더 많이써서 두뇌활동에 좋은 자극이 될것 같아요
3. 떡말이어묵과 어묵고로케 장난감 재잔이 쫀쫀하고 안전해보여요
4. 평소 좋아하누 삼진어묵과 바잇미 콜라보로 연두랑 놀이할때도 귀여워서 더 자주 손이 가요
reviews.content_en:
1. The outer packaging of both the tteokmal eomuk and eomuk croquette has the cute Samjin eomuk logo and a realistic, perfectly-sized design. The size is just right for our pup Yeongdu (4.6kg) to play with!
2. The eomuk croquette seems slightly more difficult than the tteokmal eomuk. Dogs with lots of nose work experience like Yeongdu can still figure it out, even if it takes a bit longer!! The eomuk croquette especially requires more use of paws and snout, which seems like good mental stimulation.
3. Both the tteokmal eomuk and eomuk croquette toys have a chewy, safe material.
4. Since they're a collaboration between Samjin eomuk and BITE ME, which Yeongdu loves anyway, I find myself reaching for them more often during playtime because they're so cute!

reviews.content_en:
I bought one set of eomuk/tteokmal for my pup and one as a gift, and they're seriously so cute ☹️
I went crazy over the packaging as soon as delivery arrived, and the way they separate so easily with lots of spots to hide treats is such a game-changer! 😭
Having the crinkle sound, squeak, and nose work all in one is amazing! I can't throw away the packaging and am keeping it 😄😄😄 The croquette eomuk is round and cute to carry around, and the tteokmal is exciting to chew on because of the velcro—adorable ❤️
If more eomuk designs come out, I think a set would be even cuter! Both my pup and I are satisfied with this adorable toy! If you're wondering, I recommend it ❤️❤️

reviews.name: 주****
reviews.content: 믿고 사는 바잇미! 삼진어묵이야 말할 것도 없이 맛있는 어묵인데 바잇미와의 콜라보라니. 바로 장바구니 숑숑 담아 구매했어요. 고로케를 담은 봉투도 너무 귀여운데 어묵 고로케 속의 작은 어묵은 정말 앙증맞은 크기입니다. 아이가 한입에 왕 물어서 삑삑 움직이기도 하는데 정말 어묵 한 알 맛나게 먹는 모양새라 웃음이 나더라구요. 그러다 고로케 겉면의 바스락 소리를 내주면… 동영상처럼 와악 달려들어 뺏어갑니다… 긔여운 녀석… 아, 그리고 바스락 소리가 정말 야무지게 나는 편이라 집안 어딘가에서 사고치느라 제 눈앞에 안 보일 때 요거 들고 바스락 거리면 호다닥 달려오기도 해요. 어쩌다보니 대형사고 방지용(?)으로도 사용하고 있어요. 아무튼! 파괴해버리기 전에 하나 더 미리 사두려고 합니다. 사이즈, 구성, 위트 모두 담은 삼진어묵! 훌륭한 장난감 만들어주셔서 감사합니다. ୧( ⁼̴̶̤̀ω⁼̴̶̤́ )૭
reviews.content_en: BITE ME is a trusted buy! And Samjin eomuk is delicious, so a collaboration with BITE ME? I immediately added it to my cart and bought it. The bag with the croquette is so cute, and the tiny eomuk inside the croquette is adorably bite-sized. My pup takes one big bite and it squeaks—watching her happily 'eat' just one eomuk makes me laugh! Then when she hears the crinkle sound from the croquette's outer layer, she dashes in and snatches it 😭 Such a cute girl... Oh, and the crinkle sound is really satisfying, so when she's getting into mischief somewhere I can't see, I rattle this and she comes running. Accidentally using it as a disaster prevention tool (?) too! Anyway, I'm planning to buy one more before she destroys it. Samjin eomuk with just the right size, composition, and charm! Thank you for making such a wonderful toy. ୧( ⁼̴̶̤̀ω⁼̴̶̤́ )૭

reviews.name: r****
reviews.content:
가성비 최고의 장난감인것 같아요
모양도 너무 귀엽고 포장보고 푸하하 진짜 어묵이네 했어요
바스락+삑삑이+노즈워크 삼박자 다 갖추고 덤으로 모양도 크기도 너무 좋아요
노즈워크때 아니여도 다른 장난감 다 놔두고 꼭 떡 물고와서 입으로 삑삑 거리면서 던져달라고 해요 ㅋㅋㅋ
저희 애기 최애 장난감 등극했어요
종일 코박고 가지고 노네요 
너무 만족스러워요 가격도 착하고👍🏻
reviews.content_en: Seems like the best value-for-money toy! The design is so adorable and when I saw the packaging I was like 'haha, it really is eomuk!' Has it all—crinkle + squeaker + nose work, and as a bonus the shape and size are perfect too. Even outside of nose work time, my pup drops all other toys and always brings the rice cake, squeaking with it in their mouth asking me to throw it haha. It's become my baby's favorite toy! Playing with their nose in it all day long. So satisfied! Great price too 👍🏻

reviews.name: 정****
reviews.content: 일단 생긴게 너무 귀엽고 뽀짝해서 볼수록 사길 잘했단 생각이 들었어요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 크기는 쪼맨한데 삑삑이, 바스락, 노즈워크까지 되니까 1석3조 가성비 장난감 인정!!! 여태껏 사준 장난감들 중에서 젤 잘 가지고 노는 것 같아요 가격도 요만하면 하나씩 더 살 마음 100% 입니당 ❤️ 이런 귀염뽀짝한 콜라보 장난감들 많이 만드러주세요!!!!!
reviews.content_en: First of all, it's so adorable and cute that the more I look at it, the more I think I made a great purchase hahaha! The size is tiny but since it has a squeaker, crinkle, AND nose work, it's totally 3-in-1 value! Seems like the best toy I've ever bought for my pup—they play with it the most. At this price, I'm 100% willing to buy more ❤️ Please make more of these adorable collaborations!!!!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 처음엔 너무 작아서 당황했는데,, 작아서 더 잘 가지고 노는 것 같네요~! 가격대비 품질 너무 좋고 귀여워요ㅎㅎ
reviews.content_en: I was shocked at how small it was at first,, but because it's small my pup plays with it even better~! Great quality for the price and so cute hehe

reviews.name: 조****
reviews.content:
귀여워요 애기두 엄청 좋아해요
근데 퀄이..가격이 아무리 저렴해도ㅜ
실밥 정도겠거니 하고 떼어내려했는데 주르륵 실이 풀리더라구요
이미 바스락 소리에 난리나서 그냥 줬어요
구매했던 바잇미 장난감 다 퀄 괜찮아서 구매했는데 삼진어묵은 조금 실망했어요..검수라도 해주시지
디자인 자체는 귀엽고 애가 좋아해서 잘 가지고 놀아요
reviews.content_en: It's cute and my baby really loves it. But the quality.. even though the price is cheap 😭 I thought it might just be loose threads and tried to pull them off, but threads kept unraveling. Since my pup was already going crazy over the crinkle sounds, I just gave it to them anyway. I bought it because other BITE ME toys had decent quality, but I was a bit disappointed with the Samjin Eomuk.. I wish you'd do quality control at least. The design itself is cute and my pup loves and plays with it well.

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 바잇미 삼진어묵ㅎㅎ 실제로 저는 삼진어묵을 좋아합니다ㅋㅋㅋ 마침 저희조카가 와준 특별하고도 소중한날이라 제가 좋아하는 삼진어묵을 주문해서 보내줬는데요ㅎㅎ 이렇게 생일상을 차렸네요ㅎㅎ 우리조카가 너무 좋아한다는 소식에 이모는 춤이 절로 나옵니다 ㅎㅎ 삼진어묵 이벤트도 있다던데 뽑히면 너무 좋을것 같아요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 삼진어묵 너무 맛있어요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 우리 조카도 너무 맛있게 뇸뇸 ㅎㅎ 바잇미 사랑합니다 ㅎㅎ
reviews.content_en: BITE ME x Samjin Eomuk hehe! I actually love Samjin Eomuk haha. My cousin came over on a special and precious day, so I ordered my favorite Samjin Eomuk to send them hehe. This is how we set up a birthday celebration hehe! My cousin loves it so much that your aunt is dancing with joy hehe. I heard there's a Samjin Eomuk event—I hope I win! Samjin Eomuk is so delicious hahaha! My cousin is also enjoying it so much nom nom hehe! I love BITE ME hehe

reviews.name: E****
reviews.content:
1개사면 싸울까봐 2개 주문했는데 
서로 갖고 놀려고 난리예요 아이들이 너무좋아해요♡
reviews.content_en: I ordered 2 so they wouldn't fight over 1, but they're fighting to play with them anyway! My kids love it so much ♡

reviews.name: 오****
reviews.content: 동생이 부산인가?가서 매장에서 사왔는데 너무좋아해서 생을마감한 어묵장난감을 고이보내주고 재주문함..그러나 또다시 어묵과 떡은 이별하고 어묵이 살려달라 외침..또주문해야함 신상을 좋아함
reviews.content_en: My sibling got one from a store in Busan or somewhere, and my pup loved it so much that after the old eomuk toy reached the end of its life, I respectfully laid it to rest and reordered.. but once again the eomuk and rice cake said goodbye and the eomuk is crying for help.. I need to order again. My pup loves new products!

reviews.name: B****
reviews.content: 강아지 원픽 장난감. 패브릭 장난감 러버이자 파괴자인 저희 아이가 가장 좋아하고 오래 가지고 노는 장난감이에요. 가장 가운데있는 인형은 끝까지 안터져요~! 5번째 주문
reviews.content_en: My dog's favorite toy! My pup, who's a fabric toy rubber destroyer, loves this the most and plays with it the longest. The plush toy in the very middle never gets torn! 5th reorder

reviews.name: 황****
reviews.content:
내 똥강아지 너무 좋아해요. 간식 잘 찾아먹네요. 바스락바스락 소리도 너무좋구요. 출근할때 떡어묵말이에 간식 왕창 숨겨놓고 나가면 나가는거 보지도 않고 간식 찾아 먹느라 정신 없어요.
정말 너무 만족합니다. 다른거 살까하다 고민하다가 샀는데 후회없어요.
바잇미삼진어묵 만세~~~~♥
reviews.content_en: My silly pup loves it so much. They find and eat treats well. Love the crinkle crinkle sounds too. When I leave for work, I hide tons of treats in the eomuk rice cake roll and when I go, they don't even watch me leave—they're too busy finding and eating treats. I'm really so satisfied. I was thinking about buying something else but bought this instead and no regrets. BITE ME Samjin Eomuk forever~~~~♥

reviews.name: 타****
reviews.content: 보는 순간 제가 더 구매욕심이 났던 제품이에요 완전 좋아하고 바잇이 장난감은 일단 튼튼해요 어묵알맹이 물고 다니며 삑삑거리고  바스락거리고 바잇미꺼 사준건 다 좋아해요 어묵바도 사야지 ㅋㅋ
reviews.content_en: The moment I saw it, I wanted to buy it even more! Really love it and BITE ME toys are durable. The eomuk core squeaks and crinkles as my pup carries it around, and I love everything from BITE ME. I need to get the eomuk bar too haha

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 우리조카를 위해 선물한 삼진어묵 ㅎㅎ 실제로 저도 삼진어묵을 좋아하는데 역시 내조카 맞네요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 삼진어묵 좋아하네요 ㅋㅋ 바잇미에서 삼진어묵이랑 콜라보 할거라고 예상 하나도 못했는데 이렇게 우리 조카한테 사줄수 있어서 기뻐요 !! ㅎㅎ 저희도 이벤트 당첨되서 삼진어묵 너무너무 먹고싶네요 ㅎㅎ !! 뽑아주세요!!!
reviews.content_en: Gave the Samjin Eomuk as a gift to my cousin hehe! I actually love Samjin Eomuk too, so they're definitely my cousin haha! My cousin loves Samjin Eomuk haha! I never expected BITE ME to collaborate with Samjin Eomuk, so I'm so happy I could gift this to my cousin!! We also want to win the event and eat Samjin Eomuk so much hehe!! Pick us!!!

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 숨길수있는 포인트가 여러개라 맘에들어요. 헌데 겉에 흰색포켓도 좀더 타잇하면 좋을거같아요. 넘잘빠져서 간식넣기가 애매~
reviews.content_en: I like that there are multiple spots to hide treats. But I think if the white pocket on the outside were a bit more snug it would be better. It slips out too easily so it's awkward putting treats in~

reviews.name: j****
reviews.content:
바잇미제품 너무좋아합니다
이번에도 디자인과 내구성에 너무 마음에들어요
우리애기 혼자두고 외출할때 주고가면 시간가는줄도 모르고 놀아요ㅎㅎ삼진어묵시리즈는 크기는좀 작긴한데 난이도가 좀 있어서 좋네요 찍찍이가 생각보다 강,력해서 가지고놀다보면 칼로리소모가 상당할듯해요ㅎㅎ에너지넘치는 멍멍이들이 가지고놀면 좋을듯해요
reviews.content_en: I really love BITE ME products. I'm really happy with the design and durability this time too. When I leave my pup alone and go out with this, they lose track of time playing hehe. The Samjin Eomuk series is a bit small in size, but the difficulty level is good. The velcro is surprisingly strong so they burn a good amount of calories playing with it hehe. Seems like it would be great for high-energy pups hehe

reviews.name: ㅈ****
reviews.content: 우연한 기회로 선물 받았는데 더러워지고 최애라서 새거 구매해줄려고 세일할때 샀는데 대만족입니다❤️
reviews.content_en: I got it as a gift by chance and loved it so much that I bought a new one on sale because it got dirty and was their favorite ❤️

reviews.content:
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ어묵 너무 기여워용 디테일이 진짜 어묵같고🤍🤍
얼른 저희 강아지가 갖고 놀았으면 ❤️
